title: Syrian Court Sentences Bashar al-Assad's Cousin to Death
text:
Syrian Court Sentences Bashar al-Assad's Cousin to Death"

"The criminal court of Syria's administration, headed by Abu Mohammad al-Jolani, has sentenced Wassim al-Assad, a cousin of ousted President Bashar al-Assad, to death today on alleged charges. "

"The ruling, issued by the insurgent government's judiciary, marks one of the most high-profile prosecutions against a member of the former ruling family since the fall of the Assad regime. The specific nature of the charges has not been independently verified, but the court described them as criminal offenses warranting capital punishment.
